• Meet emergencies such as droughts or floods.
• Stabilize food prices.
• Ensure continuous supply through PDS.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Buffer stock is the reserve of food grains maintained by the government.
It acts as a crucial safety net during unforeseen emergencies like droughts or floods.
It prevents price volatility by stabilizing food prices in the market.
It ensures an uninterrupted and continuous supply of food grains through the Public Distribution System (PDS).
